notes.title: Patch!
notes.notes:
I know you love the ridiculous gimmicks of this game, so now there are a few more.

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Rebalanced Economy:[/b] tools no longer drop on their own. You gotta get keys to open the chests for all tools now! (Use extra boxes in the blender to get growth juice to make your baby keys useful)
[*] [b]Simplified:[/b] only one tool per run now. It's less confusing, and the secret levels are going to unlock a different way...
[*] [b]New Tool:[/b] Single Chopstick! It's very lonely, and swiping on the dating apps hasn't helped yet
[*] [b]Updated Unlock:[/b] the stats and leaderboards menu is now available after beating Beach Day or Froyo
[*] [b]Fixed:[/b] dart guns are no longer janky on the main menu
[*] [b]Also:[/b] tools have a less boring color in your inventory
[/list]
